items.name: shad-fx-dither-engine
items.title: shad-fx: dither engine
items.description: Bayer-dithered canvas loop, seeded RNG and the colour helpers every effect builds on.
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.xyz>
items.docs: The ordered-dither rendering derives from dither-kit (MIT, https://github.com/Boring-Software-Inc/dither-kit). See https://github.com/sekeidesign/shad-fx/blob/main/NOTICE.md

items.name: shad-fx-dither-canvas
items.title: shad-fx: dither canvas
items.description: Fills its positioned parent with a pixelated canvas running a dither effect.
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.xyz>
items.docs: Pair it with one effect: `<DitherCanvas effect={fx} />`. Build the effect once (useMemo or module scope) - a new reference restarts the simulation.

items.name: use-fx-skill
items.title: shad-fx: usage skill
items.description: Agent skill: install, place and drive DitherCanvas and the effects correctly.
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.xyz>
items.docs: Lands in .claude/skills/shad-fx/ so Claude Code picks it up in this project. Pair with create-fx-skill to write new effects.

items.name: create-fx-skill
items.title: shad-fx: effect authoring skill
items.description: Agent skill: write a new effect against the engine contract, or rework how one simulates.
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.xyz>
items.docs: Lands in .claude/skills/shad-fx-new-effect/. Covers the DitherEffect contract, the two effect shapes, the Painter, reduced motion and parking.

items.name: shad-fx-dither
items.title: shad-fx: dither
items.description: The dither canvas, every dither effect, and a barrel that re-exports them.
items.author: Piergiorgio Gonni <https://www.sekei.xyz>
items.docs: Everything imports from `@/components/shad-fx/dither`. Working with an agent? `npx shadcn@latest add @sekei/use-fx-skill` installs a Claude Code skill for setting the effects up correctly.
